description: This file defines a final class 'WorkActivityStore' responsible for managing and tracking activities related to jobs and tools within an application. It includes data structures for activities, methods for handling various activity states, icon state derivation, and session management. The class is observable and interacts with external modules...

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages current activities and session states related to work jobs and tools, handles state updates, and derives icon representations based on activity status.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore.Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an activity, including session key, role, kind, label, timestamps for start and last update.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles the start or end of a job based on session key and state string.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Manages tool activities, including starting and stopping, with optional metadata.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines the icon state based on an override selection.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and trims the main session key used as the primary activity.
